batch: R04 feedback-frequency current Microsoft source recheck

sources.finding: Windows 11 Settings path is Privacy & security > Diagnostics & feedback > Feedback frequency. It adjusts how often Windows asks for user feedback; page does not list dropdown choices.

Section 18.16 states feedback frequency applies to user-generated feedback, gives Automatically/Never/Always/Once a day/Once a week mappings for PeriodInNanoSeconds and NumberOfSIUFInPeriod, and labels both REG_DWORD.

discrepancy: Microsoft labels both values REG_DWORD, but daily 864000000000 and weekly 6048000000000 exceed the unsigned DWORD maximum 4294967295. Neither source establishes a corrected value type or a current-build UI payload. Do not coerce, truncate, reinterpret, or write these values.
